methods.Crown: highest body vertex; hair is a separate object so this is the skull top
methods.Chin: lowest z where the central front surface is still within 15% of head width of the mouth-level front
methods.Mouth: mean z of the upper and lower teeth objects
methods.Eye*: bounding box of the eyeball objects; corners are the eyeball extents, so eye width is slightly overstated
methods.Nipple: centroid z of the DEF-breast vertex groups
methods.HeelBack_L/ToeTip_L: y extremes of the left foot vertices below 4% of height
methods.unreliable_metrics: eye gap and eye height/width need the eye OPENING; Hina only has eyeball objects

not_measurable.Pubis: Hina's thighs touch down to the knees, so there is no leg gap to find the crotch from

_meta.skipped: Navel, shoulder/elbow/wrist/hip/knee/ankle, HandTip: Hina has no armature, so joints cannot be measured
